$schema: Ordered modules. Each lesson ID must exist in src/data/lessons/*.json. Module IDs are stable identifiers (they no longer match the display number after the 2026 expansion); the number field sets the display order. Levels are approximate and are not official CEFR certification.

modules.title: Pronunciation and orthography
modules.description: The alphabet, vowels, c and g, sc, gn, gli, stress, double consonants, accents and the apostrophe.

modules.title: Nouns and articles
modules.description: Gender, plurals, definite and indefinite articles, irregular nouns.

modules.title: Adjectives
modules.description: Agreement and position, demonstratives, possessives, bello/buono, comparison.

modules.title: Regular verbs in the present
modules.description: A map of the whole verb system; infinitives, stems, subject pronouns, and the three regular conjugations.

modules.title: Essential irregular verbs
modules.description: essere, avere, andare, fare, stare, dire, and other high-frequency irregular verbs.

modules.title: Building sentences
modules.description: Word order, negation, questions, question words and conjunctions.

modules.title: Prepositions
modules.description: The simple prepositions and their contractions with the article.

modules.title: Modal verbs
modules.description: potere, volere, dovere, sapere + infinitive.

modules.title: Reflexive verbs
modules.description: Reflexive pronouns and daily routines.

modules.title: Imperativo
modules.description: Commands for tu, noi, voi and the formal Lei/Loro; the negative imperative; pronouns with the imperative; short forms (va’, fa’, di’).

modules.title: Passato prossimo and auxiliaries
modules.description: The compound past; choosing avere or essere (including verbs that take both and modal verbs); full past-participle agreement.

modules.title: Imperfetto and trapassato prossimo
modules.description: The imperfect and its uses, choosing between imperfetto and passato prossimo, and the pluperfect.

modules.title: Pronouns and complex sentences
modules.description: Direct and indirect object pronouns, ne and combined pronouns, relative clauses (che, cui, il quale), adverbs and story expressions.

modules.title: Futuro
modules.description: Futuro semplice and futuro anteriore: future time, anteriority in the future, and supposition about the present and the past.

modules.title: Condizionale
modules.description: Condizionale presente and passato: politeness, wishes, advice, hypothetical consequences, reported information and the future in the past.

modules.title: Infinitive, gerund and participle
modules.description: The non-finite forms: infinito presente and passato, gerundio presente and passato, stare + gerundio, participio passato and the participio assoluto.

modules.title: Passato remoto
modules.description: The narrative past: regular and irregular forms (including alternatives such as credei/credetti), its use in writing and its very different use in speech across Italy; the trapassato remoto.

modules.title: Congiuntivo
modules.description: All four tenses of the subjunctive: when it is required, when it alternates with the indicative, and what changes with register.

modules.title: Complex sentences
modules.description: The periodo ipotetico, the sequence of tenses (concordanza dei tempi) and indirect speech.

modules.title: Passive and impersonal constructions
modules.description: The passive with essere, venire and andare; si passivante and si impersonale.
